scope: MVP-3 acceptance skeleton for real/fallback/degraded adapter integration behind existing adapter boundaries, starting with fixture and replay safety before provider execution.

fixture_checks.purpose: empty MVP-3 replay safety skeleton with no provider execution
fallback/degraded adapter replay with recorded real/fallback/degraded outcomes

scenarios.assertion: MVP-3 Slice 0 fixtures are deterministic, GitHub-safe, synthetic/redacted/minimal, and contain no provider execution.
Future Slice 1 profile contract must use provider-agnostic metadata and fail closed for mock-only or credential-like profiles.
Future Slice 2 adapter harness must emit canonical health/error/degraded events through the callback append boundary.
Future Slice 3 runtime assembly must record validated capability snapshots without provider probes.
Future Slice 4 ASR contract must use explicit output modes and safe refs.
Future Slice 5 Thinker contract must normalize structured output before downstream use.
Future Slice 6 Slow LLM contract must make validation failure event-visible.
Future Slice 7 TTS contract must use safe audio refs and explicit truncate degradation.
Slice 8 replay distinguishes real/fallback/degraded adapter outcomes, canonical retry/failure/validation/degraded paths, and old-plan adapter output without provider rerun.
Future Slice 9 acceptance must reject unsafe fixtures, direct provider calls, and scope broadening.
